objective: Test whether a simple market-momentum timing overlay on the frozen V16 ungated signal materially improves win rate and reduces drawdown, without introducing look-ahead.
hypothesis_origin: Exploratory analysis on the V16 2020-2025 retrospective window found that holding only when the prior rebalance period benchmark return was positive transformed the V16 ungated line from a 48 percent win rate and -33.8 percent drawdown into a 94 percent win rate and near-zero drawdown. This is a retrospective discovery and must be re-verified under a frozen, pre-registered protocol; it is not yet evidence.

timing_rule.signal: prior rebalance period benchmark return (20 trading days)
timing_rule.initial_state: before enough history accumulates, hold the portfolio (in_market=True)
timing_rule.look_ahead_guard: the timing signal uses only benchmark returns from periods already fully elapsed at the rebalance date

model: reuses the frozen V16 word-char ensemble text model exactly (fit and score), only the portfolio holding decision changes

modes.v16_ungated: the V16 ungated line without timing, as the same-run control
modes.v17_timing: the V16 ungated line with the market-momentum timing overlay

gates.timing_win_rate_at_least_plus_10pct: timed win rate at least 10 percentage points above the untimed line
gates.timing_reduces_drawdown: timed max drawdown no worse than untimed
gates.timing_excess_positive: timed cumulative excess over benchmark positive
gates.timing_not_fewer_positive_years: timed positive-excess years at least as many as untimed
gates.timing_holds_at_least_30pct: timed line is in the market at least 30 percent of periods (no vacuous all-cash strategy)

decision_rule.all_gates_passed: the timing overlay replaces the untimed line as the preferred presentation; still no execution authorization and still requires the future shadow protocol
decision_rule.any_gate_failed: decision stays keep_v6 and the timing result is recorded as a retrospective observation

honest_reporting: the timing signal was discovered on the same 2020-2025 window reused by V3-V16, so a pass here is weaker evidence than the future shadow protocol
only 73 rebalance periods; a 94 percent win rate has a wide confidence interval
timing improves the result by avoiding down markets, not by improving stock selection skill
